statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is low during the weekend closure because no live Nasdaq path can establish persistent mean-reversion failure; Stress remains extreme from rates and Gulf energy risk.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; Tail is below the block threshold, while extreme Stress reflects macro and geopolitical conditions rather than an observed one-way Nasdaq path.
headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low while rate and Gulf Stress remain extreme
body: Nasdaq futures are closed, so no live continuation or failed-retracement path can be verified. Friday's 162,000 payroll gain lifted Treasury yields and rate-hike expectations; oil and Hormuz risks keep reopening-gap uncertainty material.
